answer: Men and women have had very similar roles across all cultures and histories; for instance both wound ropes and held clothes over their heads when tending fires, both walked in front of the pack when hunting, birthing was an individual process without a midwife, and both also wore the same style of clothing. Because of this shared role set, there is no basis requiring men to be breadwinners or women to be caregivers, and any efforts to divide tasks peacefully can deepen societal divisions.
